title: Attention Is All You Need (Transformer)
summary: Ashish Vaswani, Noam Shazeer, Niki Parmar, Jakob Uszkoreit, Llion Jones, Aidan N. Gomez, Lukasz Kaiser, and Illia Polosukhin submitted 'Attention Is All You Need' to arXiv on June 12, 2017. The paper proposes the Transformer, a sequence-transduction architecture based on attention mechanisms without recurrence or convolution, and reports experiments on machine translation plus English constituency parsing.
significance: A documented neural-network architecture milestone introducing the Transformer described in the original paper and later published in the NeurIPS 2017 proceedings.

verification.note: The original arXiv record establishes the title, authors, June 12 2017 initial submission date, and the Transformer architecture claims recorded here. The official NeurIPS 2017 proceedings independently corroborate the paper, authors, publication venue, attention-only architecture, and reported machine-translation results. The day-precision date is attached specifically to the arXiv submission milestone, not asserted as an architecture-birth date. No institutional geography, ancestry, influence, causality, or relationships are inferred.
